top_choice_rationale: P001 most strongly combines a defined virus-like-particle vaccine achievement with mature, direct prevention of HPV infection and related cancers. Its three-person attribution is credible when the citation remains confined to that achievement, without claiming all foundational virology, clinical development, or implementation.
